relations.subject: E. Geoffrey Parrinder
relations.evidence: Interested in religion and mission studied 1929-32 at Richmond College, London.

relations.subject: E. Geoffrey Parrinder
relations.evidence: 1946-49 in French circuit in Guernsey, then to Nigeria, teaching at University College in Ibadan as Senior Lecturer.

relations.subject: E. Geoffrey Parrinder
relations.evidence: During furloughs passed B.A. and B.D. in London. Ph.D. 1946 London.

relations.subject: E. Geoffrey Parrinder
relations.evidence: From 1958 Reader, 1970 Professor of Comparative Study of Religion at King’s College in London, 1977 emeritus.
